instruction: I want to enable automatic synchronization of IMAP folders for offline use. Could you help me configure Thunderbird to automatically sync my mail folders for offline access?

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling automatic offline synchronization. This setting (mail.server.default.autosync_offline_stores) is checked in the original task's unexpect rules (set to false), so the task here requires enabling it (set to true).
metadata.verified: Based on original task - mail.server.default.autosync_offline_stores is referenced in unexpect rules as false, task here requires enabling it to true

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator checks the correct Thunderbird preference (mail.server.default.autosync_offline_stores) that controls automatic offline synchronization
Expected value (true) is semantically correct for enabling the feature as required by the instruction
Postconfig correctly closes Thunderbird window to ensure preferences are flushed to disk before verification
Getter (get_vm_file) correctly extracts the prefs.js file from the VM at the correct path
Metric (check_thunderbird_prefs) correctly parses the prefs.js file using regex and JSON parsing, then verifies the preference value
Data flow is semantically correct: close app → extract file → parse preferences → verify setting
Edge cases are handled (returns 0.0 if result file is None, handles escaped characters in regex)
Complete coverage: the single requirement in the instruction (enable auto-sync) is fully verified by the evaluator

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
